responsibility: Implements trait-bound discovery and trait-bound-aware type metadata for TyTy. It scans trait impl blocks and builtin lang-item traits to find bounds satisfied by a receiver, resolves HIR trait paths into cached TypeBoundPredicate objects with generic arguments, performs receiver-specific associated-item substitution for bounds, applies associated-type bindings during substitution, and provides the supporting TypeBoundsMappings utilities used by TyTy types to carry and compare bound sets.
same_name_distinction: Implements the bound-solving behavior for this stem: probing impls and lang items, resolving trait paths into predicates, substituting associated items for a receiver, and defining TypeBoundsMappings methods. The header just introduces the bound-carrier and item wrapper types.
